input: Preloaded exact UTF-8 bytes; strict XML, internal DTD/entities expanded, whitespace/comments/PI retained, no external resolver.
retention: Fresh child per fixture/engine; warm parser and common-model digest; three parse/consumed-digest/root-held-full-GC/root-cleared-full-GC cycles. Retention is held-live minus released-live after the same parse, avoiding unrelated pool trimming against a pre-parse baseline. Pre-parse heap and released delta also reported. Input bytes preloaded; parse allocations separate; retained 9 MiB positive control.
retentionTarget: sum(candidate fixture medians) / sum(BCL fixture medians) <= 0.75; publish every fixture without exclusions and geometric mean separately.

steadyOperations.semantics: Decode and construct owned DOM from same UTF-8 bytes; consume real root; destruction/GC lifecycle additionally reported.
Existing DOM outside timing; serialize complete owned document to UTF-8 bytes, formatting disabled; consume output length and verify parsed common-model digest.
Existing DOM and compiled fixture expression outside timing; evaluate same count expression; consume verified numeric result.
Same preloaded UTF-8 byte stream; include reader construction/disposal, consume every element/text event; BCL reader versus Xemele reader and SAX.

timing: Dedicated hardware still required; no local qualification/retention run supplies throughput or regression credit. Native/Rust steady timing excludes startup and IPC and repeats in-process operations. Managed BenchmarkDotNet classes require MemoryDiagnoser and ShortRunJob.
